catalog.description: Unprivileged proposal ONLY: no approval, scheduler or Kaggle access.

catalog.description: Status from a host-bound receipt snapshot, never live provider polling.

Check model applicability without treating element coverage as qualification.
Validate the retained LiAlO2 representation without claiming stability.
Propose a calculation under an explicit free CPU budget.
Retrieve the host snapshot status of that proposal.
